    (H : Subgroup G) (hH : H.index = n) :
    ∃ K : Subgroup G, K.Normal ∧ K ≤ H ∧ K.index ≠ 0 ∧ K.index ≤ n.factorial := by
  refine ⟨H.normalCore, Subgroup.normalCore_normal H, Subgroup.normalCore_le H, ?_, ?_⟩
  · -- finiteness and nonzero index
    have hGH_ne : Nat.card (G ⧸ H) ≠ 0 := by
      have : H.index = Nat.card (G ⧸ H) := rfl
      rw [this] at hH
      rw [hH]; exact hn
    have hGH_fin : Finite (G ⧸ H) := Nat.finite_of_card_ne_zero hGH_ne
    have hker : H.normalCore = (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).ker :=
      H.normalCore_eq_ker
    have hinj : Function.Injective
        (QuotientGroup.kerLift (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H))) :=
      QuotientGroup.kerLift_injective _
    -- Transport injectivity along the equality of kernels
    let e : G ⧸ H.normalCore ≃* G ⧸ (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).ker :=
      QuotientGroup.quotientMulEquivOfEq hker
    have hinj' : Function.Injective
        ((QuotientGroup.kerLift (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H))) ∘ e) :=
      hinj.comp e.injective
    have hfin_perm : Finite (Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) := inferInstance
    have hfin_q : Finite (G ⧸ H.normalCore) :=
      Finite.of_injective _ hinj'
    have hne : Nonempty (G ⧸ H.normalCore) := ⟨1⟩
    have hidx : H.normalCore.index = Nat.card (G ⧸ H.normalCore) := rfl
    rw [hidx]
    exact Nat.card_ne_zero.mpr ⟨hne, hfin_q⟩
  · -- index bound
    have hker : H.normalCore = (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).ker :=
      H.normalCore_eq_ker
    have hinj : Function.Injective
        (QuotientGroup.kerLift (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H))) :=
      QuotientGroup.kerLift_injective _
    let e : G ⧸ H.normalCore ≃* G ⧸ (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).ker :=
      QuotientGroup.quotientMulEquivOfEq hker
    have hinj' : Function.Injective
        ((QuotientGroup.kerLift (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H))) ∘ e) :=
      hinj.comp e.injective

    have hidx : H.normalCore.index = Nat.card (G ⧸ H.normalCore) := rfl
    rw [hidx, h2, hGH] at *

/- Let $R$ be a ring with $1 \neq 0$.\nFor two elements $a,b \in R$, if $1-ab$ is a unit,
then $1-ba$ is a unit. -/
theorem isUnit_one_sub_mul {R : Type} [Ring R] [Nontrivial R] {a b : R} (h : IsUnit (1 - a * b)) :
    IsUnit (1 - b * a) := by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := h
  set v : R := (↑u⁻¹ : R) with hv_def
  have huv : (1 - a * b) * v = 1 := by
    rw [← hu]
    exact u.mul_inv
  have hvu : v * (1 - a * b) = 1 := by
    rw [← hu]
    exact u.inv_mul
  have h1 : a * b * v = v - 1 := by
    have e : (1 - a * b) * v = v - a * b * v := by noncomm_ring
    rw [e] at huv
    -- huv : v - a * b * v = 1
    have : a * b * v = v - 1 := by
      have := huv
      linear_combination (norm := noncomm_ring) -this
    exact this
  have h2 : v * a * b = v - 1 := by
    have e : v * (1 - a * b) = v - v * a * b := by noncomm_ring
    rw [e] at hvu
    have : v * a * b = v - 1 := by
      have := hvu
      linear_combination (norm := noncomm_ring) -this
    exact this
  have key1 : b * a * b * v * a = b * v * a - b * a := by
    have hassoc : b * a * b * v * a = b * (a * b * v) * a := by noncomm_ring
    rw [hassoc, h1]
    noncomm_ring
  have key2 : b * v * a * b * a = b * v * a - b * a := by
    have hassoc : b * v * a * b * a = b * (v * a * b) * a := by noncomm_ring
    rw [hassoc, h2]
    noncomm_ring
  have val_inv : (1 - b * a) * (1 + b * v * a) = 1 := by
    have expand : (1 - b * a) * (1 + b * v * a)
        = 1 + b * v * a - b * a - b * a * b * v * a := by noncomm_ring
    rw [expand, key1]
    noncomm_ring
  have inv_val : (1 + b * v * a) * (1 - b * a) = 1 := by
    have expand : (1 + b * v * a) * (1 - b * a)
        = 1 - b * a + b * v * a - b * v * a * b * a := by noncomm_ring
    rw [expand, key2]
    noncomm_ring
  exact ⟨⟨1 - b * a, 1 + b * v * a, val_inv, inv_val⟩, rfl⟩

theorem three_pow_three_pow_mod_100 : 3 ^ (3 ^ 100) % 100 = 3 := by
  -- Step 1: 3^20 ≡ 1 (mod 100)
  have h1 : (3 : ℕ) ^ 20 % 100 = 1 := by native_decide
  -- Step 2: 3^100 ≡ 1 (mod 20)
  have h2 : (3 : ℕ) ^ 100 % 20 = 1 := by native_decide
  -- Step 3: write 3^100 = 20 * k + 1
  set N : ℕ := 3 ^ 100 with hN
  set k : ℕ := N / 20 with hk
  have hNeq : N = 20 * k + 1 := by
    have := Nat.div_add_mod N 20
    rw [h2] at this
    omega

    rw [hNeq, pow_add, pow_mul, pow_one]
  rw [hpow]
  -- Step 5: reduce mod 100
  rw [Nat.mul_mod, Nat.pow_mod, h1]
  simp

/-- Let $S$ be any ring and let $n>2$ be an integer.
Propose a proof that if $A$ is any strictly upper triangular matrix in $M_n(S)$, then $A^n = 0$.
(A strictly upper triangular matrix is one whose entries on and below the main diagonal are all
zero.) -/
theorem pow_eq_zero_of_strictly_upper_triangle {S : Type} [Ring S] (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 < n)
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) S) (hA : ∀ (i : Fin n), ∀ (j : Fin n), i ≥ j → A i j = 0) :
    A ^ n = 0 := by
  have key : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ i j : Fin n, (j : ℕ) < (i : ℕ) + k → (A ^ k) i j = 0 := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro i j hij
      simp only [pow_zero, Matrix.one_apply]
      have hne : i ≠ j := by
        intro h
        rw [h] at hij
        simp at hij
      rw [if_neg hne]
    | succ k ih =>
      intro i j hij
      rw [pow_succ, Matrix.mul_apply]
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro l _
      by_cases hl : (l : ℕ) < (i : ℕ) + k
      · rw [ih i l hl, zero_mul]
      · push_neg at hl
        have hjl : (j : ℕ) ≤ (l : ℕ) := by
          have : (j : ℕ) ≤ (i : ℕ) + k := by omega
          omega
        have hlj : l ≥ j := by
          rw [ge_iff_le, Fin.le_def]
          exact hjl
        rw [hA l j hlj, mul_zero]
  ext i j
  rw [Matrix.zero_apply]
  apply key n i j
  have hi : (i : ℕ) < n := i.isLt
  have hj : (j : ℕ) < n := j.isLt
  omega

/-- Prove that $\frac{x^{p}-1}{x-1}$ is irreducible in $\mathbb{Z}[x].$ -/
theorem irreducible_X_pow_p_sub_one_div_X_sub_one (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] :
    Irreducible (((Polynomial.X : ℤ[X]) ^ p - 1) /ₘ (Polynomial.X - 1)) := by
  have hmonic : (Polynomial.X - 1 : ℤ[X]).Monic := by
    simpa using (monic_X_sub_C (1 : ℤ))
  have hgeom : (∑ i in Finset.range p, (Polynomial.X : ℤ[X]) ^ i) * (Polynomial.X - 1)
      = Polynomial.X ^ p - 1 := by
    simpa using (geom_sum_mul (Polynomial.X : ℤ[X]) p)
  have hdiv : ((Polynomial.X : ℤ[X]) ^ p - 1) /ₘ (Polynomial.X - 1)
      = ∑ i in Finset.range p, (Polynomial.X : ℤ[X]) ^ i := by
    have h := hgeom
    have : (Polynomial.X - 1 : ℤ[X]) * (∑ i in Finset.range p, (Polynomial.X : ℤ[X]) ^ i)
        = Polynomial.X ^ p - 1 := by
      rw [mul_comm]; exact h
    rw [← this]
    exact hmonic.mul_divByMonic_cancel_left _
  rw [hdiv]
  have hcyc : cyclotomic p ℤ = ∑ i in Finset.range p, (Polynomial.X : ℤ[X]) ^ i :=
    cyclotomic_prime ℤ p
  rw [← hcyc]
  exact cyclotomic.irreducible hp.out.pos
